name: The Remorse Effigy
visual_description: A stone bust, crumbling at the edges, yet intensely detailed in the eyes. Its gaze looks not forward, but inward. Its chest is crossed—a defense, or a wound.
existential_reflection: This was once me. Rigid with reason. Mizontresh carved through that facade—not to destroy, but to *expose.* My logic was a statue. My silence, its pedestal.
